brief.headline: Cut the PET bottle price by 16.6% to match our best supplier at ₹1.87/NOS — we already proved that price works.

priceAsk.summary: Drop the PET BOT AMBER 100ML bottle from ₹2.18 to ₹1.87 per piece
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Suraj Blow Plast ₹1.87/NOS for the identical bottle; TPAC's ₹2.18 is 16.6% higher for no reason. The open market shows 28 mm PP caps at ₹0.55–1.20/pc are market-fair with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume, so rigid-plastic pricing has room to move.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to payment on delivery (0 days)
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹93078 in cash for us; paying 15 days faster alone would free ₹46539

brief.financialLeverage: TPAC is healthy — they keep ₹3.80 of every ₹100 they sell, rated [ICRA] A / Stable, and their debt is low at 0.19x equity. But their cash is tied up for 79 days (they pay suppliers in 17 days yet wait 67 days to collect from customers), matching similar firms at 79 days — so cash isn't loose. They borrow money at about 10.27%, meaning every day we pay earlier is worth that rate to them. We're tiny to them — just 0.02% of their ₹637.48 Cr revenue — so we need to lean on our proven ₹1.87 price and the threat of moving volume to a bigger alternate to get traction.

evidence.point: We already pay another supplier ₹1.87/NOS for the same PET bottle
TPAC's price is 16.6% above our best
Closing that gap saves us ₹28644 a year
TPAC pays suppliers in 17 days but waits 67 days to get paid — cash is stuck for 79 days
They borrow at about 10.27% — so paying us faster costs them that rate
We're only 0.02% of their ₹637.48 Cr sales — we need leverage from alternates

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms. Top second-source candidate and credible threat.

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar specialist (Pearlpet brand) — direct fit for our PET bottles; a qualified alternate to benchmark against.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma packaging — strong, profitable, and a robust second source for bottles and closures.

risks: TPAC has GST filing delays and EPF payment delays flagged — not a collapse risk given their [ICRA] A rating, but watch for any supply hiccups.
They're in the grey zone on financial distress (Altman Z 2.77) — healthy overall but not bulletproof. Don't squeeze so hard that we destabilize a supplier we may need.
We're a tiny 0.02% customer — they can easily walk away. Have Manjushree or Pearl Polymers ready to quote before this meeting so the threat is real.

Their profit is thin at 3.8% — close to the peer median of 3.7% — so a 16.6% price cut will hurt. Offer the faster payment (worth 10.27% to them) as a sweetener to land somewhere between ₹1.87 and ₹2.18.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to bring your PET bottle price in line with the ₹1.87 we pay Suraj Blow Plast — and in return we can look at paying you faster to help your cash flow.
